frame.physical_scale: One common world/pixel scale calibrated to the existing female SOUTH head width, including ears, at alpha>128. Authored family-scale choice, not a recovered native height.
frame.units: width and center_x are Qud cell-width units (2/3 world); height and center_z are world units. No per-facing rescale.

native_facts: Horns575, paired grooved bone natural equipment on Head288/0. Native data does not specify skull coordinates.
authored_estimate: Ram-like backward curl; 3D tube, root separation, lateral splay and skull depth are authored estimates, not native joint coordinates.
geometry: One shared tapered round tube. X lateral, Y down, Z forward. Starts at paired upper anterolateral crown; rises then sweeps towards negative Z (back). Returning tip turns forward above ears. Cross sections retain volume, and camera rotation reverses near/far tube surfaces.
depth: Intact item retained. Source volume determines near/far ownership; original skull separates anterior roots from posterior arc. Masks are derived only after full item drawing, without changing the bare head or adding ears.

views.south: Upper anterior crown roots visible. Posterior arc is farther away; inner returning tip has its own self-occlusion. Original flesh ears stay below the coil.
views.east: Root above/forward of original ear. Initial arc rises and sweeps screen-left towards back, then returns forward. Exact right profile, common scale; far horn overlaps near horn.
views.north: Anterior roots are behind original skull. Posterior tube arc is nearer than the skull and overlaps its upper sides. Returning tip can be concealed by that nearer tube surface; never paste the front inner spiral onto the rear. No bone ear.
views.west: Mirror east for the symmetric natural paired item; same binding Head288/0, no independent enlargement.

acceptance: Inspect self-occlusion, rear surface, root depth and tip visibility in manual and first refined views before registration. A similar symmetric silhouette alone is neither proof of error nor proof of coherence.
